newsitem.title: UK: Cadbury up amid talk of options buying.
newsitem.headline: Cadbury up amid talk of options buying.

text.p: Cadbury Schweppes Plc shares rose two percent on Tuesday, amid talk of a buyer in the options market and speculation Unilever Plc could use its cash pile to bid for the chocolate and drinks group, dealers said.
Long a rumoured bid target, Cadbury shares were up 12p to 597 by 0904 GMT in volume of 1.7 million shares.
Dealers said there had been a buyer of the August 600p calls on the stock and said there was renewed talk of a possible bid from Unilever, which reported first-half results last Friday.

The rise in Cadbury shares came despite a downgrade from Lehman Brothers, which cut the stock to "neutral" from "buy" on concerns of an increased involvement with independent bottlers in the United States.
